shots.title: V01 · Build from timeline
shots.caption: Storyboard: press Story on the toolbar and "Build from timeline". Every day with dated cards becomes a "what happened" scene (many days are merged into spans), then "what the evidence shows" from confirmed indicators, "assessment" from the judgement, and "what we ask for". Each scene carries the cards that back it.

shots.title: V02 · Edit a scene
shots.caption: Editing a scene: the title, the kind (what happened, what we found, what we assess, what we ask for), the date range and a caption that cites exhibits. Add the board's selected card or pick any pinned card; remove with ×; reorder with the arrows. Everything is saved on the case, so it syncs and versions like the rest.
marks: Add a card to the scene

shots.title: V03 · AI-drafted scenes
shots.caption: Draft with AI: the model (or the rules engine when no key is configured) writes scenes from the whole case — notes, exhibits, threads, hypotheses — with captions citing exhibit numbers that are checked against the board. Replace your scenes or append to them.

shots.title: V04 · Play
shots.caption: Play: a full-screen view of one scene at a time — kind and dates, title, caption, the cards as tiles. Arrow keys or the buttons move between scenes; Esc returns to the editor. Made for the briefing room.

shots.title: V05 · Printed storyboard
shots.caption: Print: a cover with the scene list, then one page per scene with the kind, dates, caption and the exhibits as tiles. Save as PDF from the browser for a hand-over or a leadership pack.

shots.title: V06 · Brief chapter
shots.caption: The case brief prints the storyboard as a chapter before the timeline: every scene with its kind, dates, caption and the exhibits it cites, so the narrative and the evidence tables travel together.

shots.title: V07 · Storyboard on the share page
shots.caption: On the public page the storyboard comes first: scene by scene, with the exhibits each one rests on as chips. Readers get the narrative before the tables, and only the cards the team pinned.
